finalText:
**Build is green again.** Exit code `0`, no errors.

You were right, two of them were real. Both came from the bundler bump.

1. `src/core/options.js` still read `options.retries`. The new shape is `retryCount`. It now reads the new name, falling back to the old.
2. `src/net/retryPolicy.js` threw on an unset flag. The new loader leaves it `undefined`. That now means off, like before.

The remaining 8 warnings are just noise. They are deprecation notices printed by the bundler itself. The files they name are not in this project.
